camera.motion: static (mean abs grey diff outside moving column <=0.35/255 between consecutive frames, 0.46 frame0 vs 44)
camera.view: near top-down view of a xiangqi board on tatami; 2D scene, motion in the board plane; image +y = direction of motion
camera.perspective_note: slight perspective: glyph (top face) centre drifts ~0.0038*(y-170) px relative to silhouette bbox centre (~ -0.6 px at y=156, +2.8 px at y=968); apparent diameter of moving piece constant 86-87 px over the board (no size change)

moving_objects.name: red_general
moving_objects.desc: red-glyph 帥/帅 general (light wooden disc with red character), the centre (5th) piece of the top (red) back row; the only object that moves
moving_objects.reference_point: silhouette bbox centre in image (= disc centre; best proxy for origin)
moving_objects.visible_frames: 0-41 fully (40-41 over tatami rim/off-board), 42 sliver at bottom edge, 43-44 out of frame
moving_objects.path: straight line along the board's empty centre file, x = 959.2 +/-0.1 px, y increasing (top->bottom of image), from y=156 (frame 0) to y=968 (frame 39), leaves the board bottom edge (~y 1008-1017) at about frame 40-41 and the image at frame 42-43

events.note: first detectable displacement frame1->2 (+0.76 px); increments then grow ~1.1-1.2 px per frame each frame (steady speed-up, no direction change)

events.event: crosses board bottom rim / leaves board onto tatami

events.note: frame 42 only a 14 px sliver visible (y 1066-1079)
each pair shows the identical image; the first of each pair shows the position belonging to the next frame (step skipped). See notes.md
